name: Canopy SkyFire Group Limited
summary: Canopy SkyFire Group Limited is an investment holding company based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, set up in 2001 and formerly named Shanyu Group Holdings Company Limited until October 2025. It designs, makes and sells two-way radios, baby monitors and plastic goods in Europe, China, the United States, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Australia. It also builds and maintains online e-commerce and supply chain software, and consults for offline platforms on data analysis and blockchain.
